prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, grey rainy daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows, warm ceiling spots.
Image 1: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Ji Ran (27), look S2
Image 3: the character sheet of Xu Banxia (24)
Image 4: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location INT. JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Camera on the front-wall side, by the pin-up wall, facing the walnut desk and the walnut door on the right wall; the camera stays on this side throughout. Lin Qingyu stands at the open walnut door on the right wall, just inside it on the pale oak floor, soaked, breathless, hair dripping, facing into the room. Ji Ran stands on the open oak floor a step from the walnut door, facing Lin Qingyu. Xu Banxia stands at the door-side corner of the walnut desk, facing them. There is one walnut desk in front of the floor-to-ceiling windows, one high-backed black leather chair behind it and one walnut door.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the pin-up wall facing the walnut desk and the walnut door. Rain streaks the floor-to-ceiling windows. Lin Qingyu stands dripping just inside the open walnut door, Ji Ran stands on the oak floor a step from the door facing him, and Xu Banxia stands at the door-side corner of the desk.
Panel 2: Medium front shot, handheld, eye level, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the walnut door, dirty single of Lin Qingyu with Ji Ran's shoulder at the frame edge. Lin Qingyu, chest heaving, wet T-shirt clinging to him, pushes his wet fringe back and bows his head apologetically, Ji Ran's shoulder at the frame edge.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye level, from the pin-up wall side angled toward the desk, clean single framed on face and shoulders. Ji Ran lets her eyes travel slowly from Lin Qingyu's face down his soaked body.
Panel 4: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, clean single of Ji Ran framed tight on face and shoulders. Ji Ran's mouth stays closed; one corner of her lips lifts in a cool, appraising half-smile.
Panel 5: Medium shot, follow Xu Banxia from the desk corner to the walnut door, eye level, from the pin-up wall side. Xu Banxia presses her lips together to hold in a laugh, walks from the desk corner past Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu, steps out through the walnut door and pulls it shut behind her.
Panel 6: Medium shot, follow Ji Ran around Lin Qingyu, eye level, camera on the pin-up wall side. Ji Ran folds her arms and walks slowly around Lin Qingyu, inspecting him, ending in front of him on the desk side, facing him, while he stands just inside the closed door.
Panel 7: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye level, on Lin Qingyu's stomach. Ji Ran's finger pokes Lin Qingyu's abdomen through the wet white T-shirt, the fabric denting with each poke.
Panel 8: Medium close-up, handheld, low angle on Lin Qingyu, dirty single with Ji Ran's shoulder at the frame edge. Lin Qingyu stands stiffly with his arms at his sides, a bead of sweat sliding down his forehead, eyes darting down to her hand.
Panel 9: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder from behind Ji Ran, eye level, angled toward the walnut door. Over Ji Ran's shoulder, Lin Qingyu swallows, a shy flush on his face.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
